newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Ometraco to sell units to Tempo.
newsitem.headline: Ometraco to sell units to Tempo.

text.p: Indonesian leasing and non-financial services firm PT Ometraco Corporation plans to sell two subsidiaries to PT Tempo Scan Pacific, Bisnis Indonesia daily reported on Monday.
The newspaper quoted Ometraco president director Boyke Gozali as saying the company will sell PT Supra Usadhatama and PT Supra Ferbindo Farma to Tempo at an estimated value of 192 billion rupiah.
Gozali said that the company would focus its business on consumer products and financial services.
"The sale will be effective next April 22," Gozali was quoted as saying by Bisnis Indonesia.
The paper said the proceeds from the deal would be used to finance Ometraco's expansion in consumer products and financial services.
It said the expansion in consumer products includes acquiring some local brands of snack foods and enhancing the company's distribution network.
In financial services, the company would use the proceeds to establish a leasing services network.
The paper also said Ometraco would invest in a life insurance company.
The paper did not provide further details.
